title: Title & Registration Services Extension Tags: Allowance for Slow State Turnaround
content:
On a Title & Registration Services order, the extension turnaround allowance is seven days when the state took more than fourteen calendar days from the order's most recent submission to its most recent return, four days when it took eight to fourteen days, and nothing otherwise. The allowance is a waiting allowance added, in whole days, on top of an extension tag's base validity.

## Records read

- the order's most recent submission date, as shown on the title order;
- the date of the latest state rejection entry on the title order, whatever its reason.

The state's turnaround is counted in calendar days from the first of these dates to the second.

## Bands

| State turnaround (calendar days) | Turnaround allowance |
|---|---|
| more than 14 | 7 days |
| 8 to 14 | 4 days |
| 7 or fewer | nothing |
| the latest return is dated before the most recent submission | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Most recent submission | Most recent return | Turnaround | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 April | 8 April | 7 | nothing |
| 1 April | 9 April | 8 | 4 days |
| 1 April | 15 April | 14 | 4 days |
| 1 April | 16 April | 15 | 7 days |
